description_en: Gets a paginated list of commit statuses
description_zh: 查询提交状态列表，支持分页
name: ListCommitStatuses

parameters.help_en: The organization ID. You can obtain the ID from the URL of your organization in Alibaba Cloud DevOps. The URL is in the format `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS) credentials to authenticate your identity
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The ID or full path of the repository
parameters.name: repository_identity

parameters.help_en: The commit ID. You must provide the SHA value of the commit
parameters.name: sha

parameters.help_zh: 页码，默认值为1，从第1页开始
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小，默认值为20，取值范围【1,100】
parameters.name: page_size
